## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector breadth is constructive but leadership is highly concentrated in Energy (Top 5 all Energy) and several large-cap Tech/Consumer names show 1W vs 1M divergences, so mixed signals support a NEUTRAL call. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads clearly: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing strength as well: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary are lagging: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, and Materials showing weakness/rotation with FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION. Big-cap Tech has important weak spots too: AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy); style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy and Financials strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION, HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Consumer names and pockets of Materials/Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers are Energy and select Tech: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across several large names (AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, CSCO) — treat as tactical noise not confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internal rotation: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND versus AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND; sector tone: selective semis strength amid large-cap dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — Financials are participating in the move and support a Value/Cyclical tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive bid: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND, but UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION — watch earnings/MA cost headlines for further dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and established Financials given narrow Energy leadership and positive sector breadth; reduce exposure to the most extended/weak large-cap Tech and soft Consumer names showing BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while monitoring the major-tech divergence for trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +10.77%) showing Sector Strength, Financials (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +3.03%) constructive. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +1.11%) remain areas of caution.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 1M highs as resistance watch (NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND) for semis leadership confirmation; AAPL support near recent swing lows (AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND) to validate pause; JPM breakout level to confirm Financials carry (JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND) and CVX pullback level as energy stability check (CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+60): Applied Materials (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price is diverging, watch for follow-through. SPG (+80): SPG likely confirming leasing/FFO upside into a Real Estate pocket that is already positive; check stock-level reaction. PYPL (+85): PayPal (1W data not shown in top list) M&A chatter — confirms Financials/Payment-space rotation if price follows.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-70): Meta (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — news and price confirm downside pressure. AAPL (-50): Apple (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — analyst downgrades and price align. CSCO (-50): Cisco (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines and big 1W drop create a divergence-risk setup.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given concentrated Energy leadership. MPC, VLO, PSX and JPM are showing relative strength (all ABOVE TREND). Key risk: narrow leadership and MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, CSCO) plus mixed news-sentiment signals (AMAT bullish but price BELOW TREND) — monitor for trend confirmation.
